name: strapi-ui-design
description: Strapi v5 admin UI design — Design System v2 compound components, page layouts, tables, forms, modals, accessibility. Ships a source-derived component-catalog.md (46 DS v2.2.1 components: real props, compound slots, deprecations). Includes a PostToolUse hook that flags DS violations in admin/src/**/*.tsx, commands (/strapi-ui-component, /strapi-ui-audit), and a strapi-ui-reviewer sub-agent.
